title: Close encounters were a big feature in North East Wales U14s' League
excerpt: IT was mainly about the close encounters in Division One of the U14s’ League.
content:
IT was mainly about the close encounters in Division One of the U14s’ League.

Broughton United Saints claimed a 2-1 triumph over Mold Alex Town, who had Alex Willis on the scoresheet. Archie Davies and Isaac Roberts won it for Saints.

Despite a brace from Harvey Reeves, FC Gresford Athletic were pipped 3-2 by Ruthin Town Blues.

Theo Rathbone, Oscar Davies and Preston Gray earned Llay United a 3-0 victory over Rhos Aelwyd.

Goals were no issue in Division Two, with Deeside Dragons Munich claiming an 8-0 outcome against Hope Dragons.

Georgie Harmes and Harry Bolton hit hat-tricks, as Eddy Williams and Riley Roberts also netted.

Jac Lloyd Edwards’ hat-trick helped Chirk to a 6-2 victory over Holywell Town, who had two-goal Aaryan Nazir on the mark. Reggie Foulkes, Theo James and Charlie Shire added further Chirk goals.

Noel Kiss, Thomas Kelly, Jacob Priddin, Henry Owen, Evan Roberts and Riley Lancaster-Heyward guided Borras Park Albion Blues to a 6-1 win against Bala, while Hawarden Rangers edged out Cei Connah 3-2. Oscar Phillips and two from Samuel Makin sealed the deal, as Alfie Morris’ brace kept Cei Connah in it.

In Division Three, Wrexham Foresters defeated Buckley Town Wanderers 4-0.

Alex Jones and Aled Edwards put Foresters in control, before Charlie Killane grabbed two goals.

Riley Jones netted a Coedpoeth United consolation in a 5-1 reverse at the hands of Ruthin Town, while Corwen pipped Rhydymwyn 2-1. Archie Davies and Rio Davies were on target for Corwen, while Efan Wyn Davies netted Rhydymwyn’s response.

Olly Brookes’ double proved to be pivotal to Cei Connah Dockers’ 3-2 triumph against Brickfield Rangers. Morgan-Lee Ford-Foyne grabbed the others for Dockers, while Arian Saha and Deniz Turan made a real game of it.

There was no shortage of goals in Division Four, where two sides came up with gr-eight displays.

Spare a thought for Emrys Griffiths, who netted a hat-trick for Brymbo. However, it was Llangollen who produced a thrilling 8-3 victory, courtesy of Cruz Masters, Timothy Calcraft (2), William Holden, Tomos Reese, Charlie Jones (2) and Jack Phoenix.

Alfie Williams hit a treble in Borras Park Albion Yellows’ 8-0 success over Mynydd Isa Dragons. Zachary Jones and Harry Earlam bagged braces with Alfie Ellis adding the other.

Deeside Dragons Milan served up a 4-2 success at Broughton United Super Saints, who had Oliver Hilton and Thomas Parsons on target. Antonion-Marcello Busuioc (2), Nikodem Babula and Oliver Stinchcomb won it.

Caleb Morris, Joseph Lloyd, Jacob Atkins and Jack Campbell struck for Gresford Athletic in their 4-1 win against Broughton United, whose scorer was Dylan Nickson.
